title: Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation Improves Small Pointwise LLM Judges
abstract: arXiv:2610.41149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly gate individual steps with a pointwise judge that scores a response against a criterion. Small language models are attractive for this role because they can be served and specialized efficiently. Such a judge must locate the criterion's decision boundary, but pointwise labels under-determine that boundary in fine-tuning: labeled responses to different queries differ along many dimensions at once, so they do not reveal which features decide the label. We introduce CPA (Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation), which makes the deciding difference explicit in training. For each pointwise item, CPA synthesizes and audits a counterfactual response to the same query intended to carry the opposite label. It frames the accepted pair as a pairwise task asking which of the two responses satisfies the criterion. The judge is fine-tuned jointly on both pointwise and pairwise datasets and deployed in pointwise mode only. A s

translated_title: 反事实成对增强提升小型逐点式LLM裁判
translated_abstract: 智能体系统越来越多地使用逐点式裁判来管控各个步骤，该裁判根据某一标准对响应进行评分。小型语言模型因其在部署和专业化方面的高效性而非常适合担任这一角色。这样的裁判必须定位标准的决策边界，但逐点标签在微调中无法充分确定该边界：针对不同查询的标注响应在多个维度上同时存在差异，因此无法揭示哪些特征决定了标签。我们提出了CPA（反事实成对增强），它在训练中使决定性差异显式化。对于每个逐点样本，CPA会针对同一查询合成并审计一个旨在携带相反标签的反事实响应，并将被接受的响应对构建为一个成对任务，询问两个响应中哪一个满足该标准。裁判在逐点和成对数据集上联合微调，但仅在逐点模式下部署。
tldr: 该论文提出CPA（反事实成对增强）方法，通过为每个逐点样本合成携带相反标签的反事实响应、并将其构建为成对任务与逐点任务联合微调，从而帮助小型LLM裁判在训练中显式感知决定性差异，更准确地定位判断标准的决策边界。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CPA (Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation), which synthesizes and audits counterfactual responses with opposite labels for each pointwise item and jointly fine-tunes on both pointwise and pairwise data, making the deciding difference explicit so that small LLM judges can better locate the criterion's decision boundary.
